rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjectival form for something located in or associated with the northwest.

example.english: The northwestern scenery is quite beautiful.
example.jyutping: sai1 bak1 min6 ge3 fung1 ging2 gei2 leng3

rows.jyutping: jau4 sai1 bak1 min6 lai4 ge3
rows.note: Use this for the from-the-northwest slice, including a wind blowing from that direction.

example.english: The wind from the northwestern direction is really cold.
example.jyutping: jau4 sai1 bak1 min6 lai4 ge3 fung1 hou2 dung3

rows.jyutping: hoeng3 sai1 bak1 min6 heoi3 ge3
rows.note: Use this when the thing or route is going toward the northwest rather than merely being located there.

example.english: This route goes in a northwestern direction.
example.traditional: 呢條路係向西北面去嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hai6 hoeng3 sai1 bak1 min6 heoi3 ge3
